DeepSeek TUI is a coding agent that runs in your terminal.
It can read and edit files, run shell commands, search the web, manage git, and coordinate sub-agents from a keyboard-driven TUI.
Full tool suite — file ops, shell execution, git, web search/browse, apply-patch, sub-agents, MCP servers
Three modes — Plan (read-only explore), Agent (interactive with approval), YOLO (auto-approved)
HTTP/SSE runtime API — deepseek serve --http for headless agent workflows
MCP protocol — connect to Model Context Protocol servers for extended tooling; please see docs/MCP.md
